# Manifest Requirements Quality Checklist: Plugin Manifest Writer and Validator Agree

**Purpose**: Author-facing pre-implementation gate on the quality of the requirements for serialization
determinism, backward-compatible loading, schema and SDK agreement, drift guards, and documentation
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and
requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only
when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not
mean implementation work is complete.

## Serialization Determinism

- [ ] CHK001 Is "byte-identical" scoped explicitly to the same manifest across calls and processes, rather than across
      SDK versions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the formatting rules that make output deterministic (indent width, key order, trailing newline,
      escaping) all stated, not just "deterministic"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the ordering of repeated fields (lists) specified as preserved from the input rather than sorted? [Gap,
      Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the omission rule for zero values and unset sections stated consistently between the edge cases and the
      data model? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the YAML scalar quoting requirement defined for strings that would otherwise read as numbers or booleans
      (for example a version `1.0` or region `no`)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-004]

## Backward-Compatible Loading

- [ ] CHK006 Are all previously written formats the loader must accept enumerated (camelCase JSON, prefixed enums,
      integer enums, old YAML field names, object timestamps)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the loader's behavior for unknown keys specified (discarded versus rejected)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it stated whether the loader validates the manifest, so callers know to call the validator? [Clarity,
      Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the behavior defined for an enum string that matches no value (for example `installation_method:
      "zip"`)? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Schema and SDK Agreement

- [ ] CHK010 Is "same verdict" defined (pass or fail only) rather than the same error message? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the `supported_resources` limits in FR-011 identical to the schema's (1 to 256, 2 to 30, billing mode
      list)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the requirement that existing validator error messages stay unchanged stated in the spec, not only in
      the plan? [Gap, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the scope of SDK and schema agreement bounded (only `supported_resources` and the new lists) given that
      other sections may still differ? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Drift Guards

- [ ] CHK014 Does FR-017 name every list it guards (methods, both capability enums, billing modes, resource type bound)?
      [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the capability string form for protocol values defined precisely enough to derive mechanically (prefix
      removal and case)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it specified whether a future capability's legacy metadata name and its manifest name may differ?
      [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the inclusion of RPCs from other services (UsageSource, Allocator, Supplemental, Scorer) in `methods`
      explicitly decided? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014]

## Documentation and Examples

- [ ] CHK018 Are the documents to update listed by path, including the registry index schema's capability description?
      [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the known failure of two example files recorded so the example requirement is testable? [Measurability,
      Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the recommended resource type form (full token) documented with at least one example per cloud or only
      for Azure? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
